title: Understanding Bag-of-Words
text: Think about how the bag-of-words model works. It counts the frequency of each word in a document. In this case, consider what 'words' might mean for DNA sequences.

title: Identifying the 'Words'
text: In the context of DNA sequences, what could be considered as 'words'? Remember, DNA is made up of sequences of letters, and these sequences can be grouped in different ways.

title: Possible Combinations
text: Consider how many different combinations of these 'words' can exist. Each 'word' is a sequence of letters, and there are a limited number of letters in DNA.

title: Calculating Dimensions
text: If each 'word' is a codon, how many possible codons are there?

title: Connecting to Bag-of-Words
text: In a bag-of-words model, each unique 'word' or codon would represent a dimension. How does this relate to the number of possible codons?
